<!--
Thank you for contributing to the Somali Language Standard!
Please read CONTRIBUTING.md before submitting. One logical change per PR —
do not mix spec changes with data changes.
-->

## Summary

What does this PR change, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Data: new/updated lexicon, terminology, translation, or corpora entries
- [ ] Spec: new or updated normative document
- [ ] Docs: documentation only
- [ ] Tooling / CI / schemas
- [ ] Other (describe)

## Related issue / discussion

<!-- Structural changes MUST link the sponsoring issue or discussion.
     e.g. Closes #123 -->

## Content checklist (for data/spec changes)

- [ ] Records validate against the relevant schema (or will, once schemas
      ship — reviewed manually until then)
- [ ] Every new record has a correct, next-in-sequence `sls_id` (no reuse,
      no renumbering)
- [ ] Every new record carries complete provenance (`contributor`, `source`,
      `date_added`, `review_status`, `license`)
- [ ] Spec documents carry complete YAML front-matter and follow
      [`docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md`](../docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md)
- [ ] No benchmark content duplicated into training datasets (or vice versa)

## Licensing & sign-off

- [ ] I have the right to contribute this content, and I license code under
      **MIT** and linguistic content under **CC BY 4.0**
- [ ] Every commit carries a DCO `Signed-off-by:` trailer (`git commit -s`)

## Reviewer notes

<!-- Anything reviewers should pay special attention to: uncertain entries,
     dialectal considerations, sources needing verification. -->
